detail.longDescription: 🧵 Wrapping up the TechEx26 thread with what is next. My talk "Who Is Asking? Agentic AI and Federation" is accepted for Internet2 Global Summit ( https:// events.internet2.edu/website/9 6909/ ) in Philadelphia on April 6. Federation assumes the party asking is a person with a browser. Agents break that at every link: which role they act in, how delegation is verified across institutions, how any of it is audited. I'll make the case the federation can answer it. # Internet2Events # GlobalSummit27 # Research # HigherEd
